allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspection of files, source code, logs, database metadata, and local development data.
Allow running project tests, focused tests, linting, type checks, and production builds.
Allow safe Node.js project scripts that inspect, validate, audit, or test the local development environment.
Allow read-only PostgreSQL queries and database coverage audits against the local development database.
Allow git status, git diff, git log, git branch, and git rev-parse.
Allow ordinary edits to files inside this project workspace when required to implement the requested phase.
block_instructions: Require approval before any production deployment or command that modifies production infrastructure.
Require approval before any destructive database operation including DROP, TRUNCATE, destructive bulk DELETE, database reset, or schema destruction.
Require approval before running migrations against any production database.
Require approval before deleting large datasets or directories.
Require approval before git push, force push, reset --hard, rebase, tag creation, tag movement, or destructive git operations.
Require approval before accessing, printing, copying, changing, or exposing secrets, API keys, credentials, SSH keys, or environment secrets.
Require approval before uncontrolled paid-provider API calls or operations that may incur material external cost.
Require approval before purchasing, provisioning, or modifying paid cloud services.
Require approval before modifying resources outside this project workspace.
Require approval before changing production security, firewall, IAM, DNS, storage, backup, or encryption configuration.
